text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a review article that synthesizes existing studies on hydrological responses to land use/land cover (LULC) changes in Ethiopian basins. While it discusses LULC changes—including past trends and future scenarios used in some cited studies—its primary purpose is not to conduct or focus on LULC future prediction itself. Instead, it reviews hydrological impacts (e.g., on runoff, streamflow, groundwater) of observed and projected LULC changes. Although some included studies employ future LULC scenarios (e.g., via CA-Markov or scenario analysis), the review does not center on evaluating or advancing LULC prediction methods or outcomes. Therefore, per instructions, because it is a REVIEW that touches on—but is not focused on—LULC future prediction, it is categorized as 'REVIEW'.)
